description:
Get the status and written result of a call placed with place_phone_call (outcome, summary, pending question, transcript on request), optionally waiting for news. Compliance: read-only; transcripts are text only (no audio is recorded) and are kept 90 days at most.

    Use it to follow a call in progress (repeat until done=true), to see whether the voice agent is waiting for the user's answer (pending_question), and to read the final outcome and summary to report to the user. Read-only: it never places, changes or ends a call.

    Returns: status (scheduled, in_progress, retry_scheduled, completed, cancelled, failed), done, outcome (success, failed, voicemail, no_answer, busy, callback_requested, callee_objected), summary, pending_question {question_id, text}, new events since after_event_id, last_event_id and next_step. A call that is busy or not answered is retried automatically (status retry_scheduled), except on lines where every call needs a new request from the user (event callback_suggested: ask the user). callee_objected means the person asked not to be called again: the transcript was deleted and the number can no longer be called; tell the user.

after_event_id.description: Return only events after this id: pass last_event_id from the previous get_call response. 0 = from the start.
after_event_id.title: After Event Id

call_id.description: The call_id returned by place_phone_call or list_calls (e.g. 'mis_…').
call_id.title: Call Id

response_format.description: 'concise' (default): status, outcome, summary, pending question and key events. 'detailed': also every transcript line, talk and hold durations, attempts and scheduled time.
response_format.title: Response Format

wait_seconds.description: Seconds (0-50) to wait for news before returning: returns early when the callee answers, the call goes on hold, the voice agent asks a question, a transfer progresses or the call ends. Use 20-30 while a call is in progress, 0 for an instant snapshot.
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

name: get_call
title: Get call status and result
